stories.title: Inside Anthropic’s trillion-dollar AI gamble
stories.take: Anthropic's S-1 is 'awesome,' per SemiAnalysis' Joey Brookhart: rapid, efficient scaling with gross margins swinging from -94% two years ago to +85% • The trillion-dollar question: today's market is narrow — the top two labs are at ~$120B ARR combined and Anthropic is concentrated in coding, almost a single-vertical company • Paths out: broader white-collar adoption, cybersecurity contracts, bio, and eventually labor replacement • Competition is closing in: OpenAI took most net new ARR in Q3 after Anthropic took 90% in H1, and open-weight models grew from ~$1B to $10B+ ARR

stories.title: Midterm Spending Blitz, GDP & Inflations Reports, Israel Election Deadlock & Iran War
stories.take: The most expensive U.S. election ever: Kansas ad spending up 10x, six-figure sums in ~70 House districts, and Rick Jackson's ~$250M Georgia governor bid • Final pre-midterm data: GDP growth accelerated on AI investment and consumer spending, but inflation is +3.7% YoY and wages lag — voters still feel squeezed • The Fed held rates after a September hike, wary of mortgage and card costs • Israel is deadlocked: Netanyahu's bloc 53 seats, Eisenkot's 48, neither at the 61 needed

stories.title: ‘AI Mode’ Is Denting Google’s Search Revenue
stories.take: Google's search revenue missed by ~$2B against a $98.5B forecast as AI Mode — less monetized than classic search — eats queries • Alphabet overall still grew 25% with cloud up 103% YoY, but search remains the profit engine analysts doubt it can replace • The contrast: Microsoft's Azure jumped 48% with lower-than-expected capex, held up as the monetization blueprint • Also: SK Hynix's $75B shareholder return and Shell raising buybacks to $5B

stories.title: Microsoft Rises, Google Tanks: Why Investors Are Polarized On Big Tech
stories.take: Why investors are polarized: Microsoft posted a clean beat — revenue +19%, Azure disclosed at +48% to a $120B+ business, shares +5% — while Google fell 11% as core ads missed, search slowed, free cash flow went -$9.1B and capex surged past $51B • Analyst Gil Luria's read: Microsoft's cash-flow discipline and capacity flexibility beat Google's spend-first AI defense • Backdrop: indices rose after the Fed's rate hold, Oracle jumped 11% on its 2029 cash-flow forecast, Brent held ~$114

stories.title: Can Montana end Citizens United?
stories.take: The answer: Montana's ballot initiative I-194 would ban corporations from contributing to campaigns by changing state corporate law — not by challenging the First Amendment — effectively ending corporate and dark-money spending in Montana elections • The stakes in numbers: outside spending went from under $400M pre-Citizens United to ~$4.5B in 2024, and ~80% of Americans call it corrupting • Backers Tom Moore and Jeff Mangan see it as a national model; legal challenges are expected

stories.title: Bolsonaro declares himself 'Brazil's leader'
stories.take: Flávio Bolsonaro, defeated and under investigation, fled to the U.S. and declared himself Brazil's true leader alleging fraud — analysts warn of strain on Brazil-U.S. relations • Spain's rail disaster: two trains collided south of Madrid, at least 68 dead and 18 critical, after the automatic signalling system failed; Sánchez declared three days of mourning • Indonesia's forest fires sparked protests demanding a national-disaster declaration • Plus the $25B micro-drama industry repurposing classic TV with AI, raising actors'-rights questions

stories.title: Dolores Huerta vigil, Scathing ruling in CA voter rolls case, OC strike resumes— Morning Edition
stories.take: A vigil honors Dolores Huerta and seven decades of farmworker organizing — the legacy of one woman's determination building a movement • A scathing ruling in the California voter rolls case, rejecting the bid to block 20,000 ballots • Prop 40, the one-time 5% tax on billionaire assets, is splitting Democrats and pushing some billionaires to leave the state • SoCal faces one more day of flooding from record high tides

stories.title: Nintendo Indie World October 2026 Live Reaction - Kinda Funny Games Daily 10.28.26
stories.take: Live reaction to Nintendo's ~15-minute Indie World: highlights include Winds of Aridia, a tree-world action adventure launching on Switch 2 early next year with a demo out today • City of None, from a Celeste co-creator — an action-puzzle platformer whose ultra-limited color palette split Tim and Blessing • Plus Tenjutsu, a martial-arts roguelike, and a wizard take on Stardew Valley from Chucklefish

stories.title: How Do We Feel About BioWare Closing? [Mailbag]
stories.take: How they feel: all three hosts are sad — Maddy Myers and Kirk Hamilton call BioWare's closing tragic, and Jason Schreier, who broke the story, calls it an inevitable slow death after EA shrank the studio from 200 people to ~50 • 400 EA jobs lost in all; Maddy blames EA's Veilguard dictates, Jason notes Anthem was largely BioWare's own bet • The consolation: the BioWare style lives on in Baldur's Gate 3, CD Projekt Red, Exodus and The Expanse game • Mass Effect 5 will now never be made

stories.title: Deadly Russian drone hits Ukrainian railway station
stories.take: A Russian drone hit a crowded platform in Dnipro, killing more than a dozen people about to board — part of a wider pattern of attacks on Ukrainian transport, with Ukraine intercepting only about half to 60% of incoming drones • Israel count at 90%: Netanyahu's bloc leads but lacks 61 seats, making conditional cooperation with Arab-led parties (~19 seats) the possible path for Eisenkot • Spain's train crash toll reached at least 69, with investigators pointing to a computer failure followed by human error • The Fed held rates steady ahead of the midterms, with cost of living voters' top concern
